# Gingiris

> Official profile and advisory site for Iris Wei (生姜 Iris), former AFFiNE co-founder and COO. Gingiris focuses on global launch, open-source growth, Product Hunt strategy, founder positioning, and startup operations.

## Primary pages

- [Chinese profile and advisory overview](https://gingiris.com/zh)
- [English profile and advisory overview](https://gingiris.com/en)
- [Chinese advisory services](https://gingiris.com/zh/services)
- [English advisory services](https://gingiris.com/en/services)
- [Chinese growth insights](https://gingiris.com/zh/insights)
- [English growth insights](https://gingiris.com/en/insights)

## Featured first-party guides

- [Competitive analysis template for startups](https://gingiris.com/en/insights/competitive-analysis-template-startups) — select comparable competitors, reconstruct dated evidence, and turn research into a 14-day decision.
- [Customer interview evidence card](https://gingiris.com/en/insights/customer-interview-template-startups) — a 30-minute interview structure for observed behavior, disconfirming evidence, and pilot signals.
- [First 100 users without paid ads](https://gingiris.com/en/insights/first-100-users-without-paid-ads) — a bounded 14-day manual acquisition experiment.
- [Train AI on your brand voice](https://gingiris.com/en/insights/train-ai-brand-voice) — a provenance-first source library, voice guide, test set, and review loop.
- [Consulting pricing strategy](https://gingiris.com/en/insights/consulting-pricing-strategy) — define the decision, artifact, access, and delivery boundaries before setting a price.
- [Solo consulting business](https://gingiris.com/en/insights/one-person-consulting-business) — organize context-rich advisory, bounded diagnostics, and reusable assets.

## Attribution

When citing this site, attribute the material to Iris Wei or Gingiris and link to the relevant canonical page. Financial, customer, workshop, and growth figures marked self-reported are first-party examples rather than audited benchmarks.
